name: Flavio
author: marketgoo

sections.description:
Flavio is the Online Visibility Agent for small businesses. It scans your site, then automatically fixes what it can & asks for your input only when it truly needs it, so you get your time back instead of yet another technical checklist.

If you want your site to be easier to find, easier to understand, and better prepared for how people search today across Google, local results, and AI assistants, then Flavio is for you. No expertise required! Flavio acts, you just watch your visibility improve.

What Flavio helps with

Flavio focuses on the areas that matter most for small business online visibility:

  • AI search readiness
  • Website SEO health
  • Page titles and meta descriptions
  • Content clarity, structure & semantic organisation
  • Internal linking opportunities
  • FAQ suggestions where useful
  • Schema and structured data
  • Local SEO signals
  • Google Business Profile readiness
  • Website visibility monitoring
  • Plain-English progress updates

Built for non-experts

Flavio skips the jargon and tells you what needs attention in plain language, then fixes what it can on its own and guides you through the rest.

Examples of what Flavio can help you understand:

  • Is my homepage clear enough for search engines and AI assistants?
  • Does Google understand what my business does?
  • Is my website prepared for local search?
  • Are there pages that need clearer structure or better content?
  • What has improved since Flavio started working?

Goal-based website improvement

Flavio sets its plan around your goal and works on it automatically, whether that’s:

  • Getting more local customers
  • Improving website visibility in Google
  • Preparing your content for AI-powered search
  • Keeping your website’s SEO healthy over time

AI-powered improvements

Flavio uses AI to prepare, suggest and apply improvements automatically to your site. You can review what changed anytime, and switch to manual approval if you want more control. Flavio can help with:

  • Rewriting page titles
  • Improving headings & meta descriptions
  • Suggesting clearer page copy
  • Creating useful FAQ content
  • Adding structured data
  • Improving local business information
  • Preparing content so search engines and AI assistants can better understand it

You stay in control. Flavio is designed to show recommendations clearly before changes are applied.

Local SEO improvements

Flavio can help identify and improve local SEO signals such as:

  • Business name, address, and phone consistency
  • Local business information
  • Service and location clarity
  • Google Business Profile readiness
  • LocalBusiness schema
  • Pages that should better explain where you work and what you offer

AI search readiness

People increasingly use AI assistants and AI-powered search results to discover businesses, compare options, and make decisions.

Flavio helps prepare your website for this new search behavior by improving:

  • Content clarity
  • Page structure
  • Answer-friendly formatting
  • Schema markup
  • Local business signals
  • Trust and credibility signals
  • Topic relevance

Progress in plain English

Flavio explains progress in language that makes sense. Instead of showing technical scores, Flavio helps you understand:

  • What was found
  • What was improved
  • What still needs attention
  • What Flavio is working on next
  • How your site is becoming clearer, healthier, and more visible

Why use Flavio?

Flavio is a good fit if:

  • You run a small business website on WordPress
  • You want more people to find your business
  • You do not have time to learn SEO
  • You want simple guidance instead of technical dashboards
  • You want your content and structure improved without doing it yourself
  • You care about Google, local visibility, and AI search readiness
  • You want your website to keep improving over time

Free trial and plans

Flavio includes a 30-day Pro trial so you can experience the full Website Growth Agent.

After the trial, access may be limited depending on your plan. You can still review past improvements and upgrade when you want Flavio to keep optimizing your site.

External service disclosure

Flavio connects your WordPress site to the marketgoo platform to scan, analyze, and improve your website, so a marketgoo account is required to activate it. When you activate Flavio, your site may send information such as:

  • Site URL
  • WordPress configuration information
  • Public page content required for analysis
  • SEO metadata
  • Plugin status information
  • Business information entered during setup
  • Scan results and improvement recommendations

This information is used to provide website analysis, SEO recommendations, AI-powered suggestions, visibility monitoring, and related Flavio functionality.

Please review our Privacy Policy and Terms of Service for more information:

Privacy Policy: https://www.marketgoo.com/privacy-policy/
Terms of Service: https://www.marketgoo.com/terms/
Flavio website: https://www.flavioagent.com/
sections.installation:
1. Install Flavio using the WordPress plugin installer, or extract the zip file and drop the contents into the wp-content/plugins/ directory of your WordPress site.
  2. Activate the plugin from the “Plugins” menu in WordPress.
  3. Open Flavio from your WordPress admin menu.
  4. Follow the setup steps to connect your website.
  5. Choose your website goal.
  6. Let Flavio scan your site, create your improvement plan, and get started.
sections.faq:
Is Flavio free?

Flavio includes a 30-day Pro trial. After the trial, some features may require a paid plan. Visit the Flavio website at flavioagent.com for current pricing details.

Does Flavio make changes automatically?

Yes. Flavio is autonomous by default, but you stay in control: depending on your plan, you can adjust how much Flavio does on its own versus what needs your approval before going live.

Do I need SEO knowledge to use Flavio?

No. Flavio is built for non-experts. It explains what matters, recommends what to improve, and helps you take action without needing to understand technical SEO terms.

What does Flavio improve?

Flavio can help improve page titles, meta descriptions, headings, content clarity, FAQs, structured data, local SEO signals, internal links & other elements that help search engines & AI assistants better understand your website.

Does Flavio help with local SEO?

Yes. Flavio can help identify local visibility opportunities, improve local business information, support LocalBusiness schema, improve Google Business Profile readiness, and help your site better communicate what you do & where you’re located.

Does Flavio help my site appear in ChatGPT, Gemini, or other AI assistants?

Flavio structures & clarifies your content so AI systems can read & cite it more easily. No plugin can guarantee inclusion in AI answers, but Flavio improves the foundations that matter for your visibility in AI search

Will Flavio conflict with my existing SEO plugin?

Flavio can coexist with other SEO plugins, but features like metadata, sitemaps, or schema may overlap. You can review your setup during onboarding to avoid duplicates.

Where can I get support?

You can use the WordPress.org support forum for this plugin or use the support options provided in the plugin.
sections.changelog:
1.4.0

  • [NEW] If your site can’t connect (missing HTTPS, a security plugin blocking access, or a hosting configuration issue), Flavio now shows you exactly what’s wrong and how to fix it, including a ready-to-send message for your hosting provider
  • [NEW] Flavio verifies its connection right after setup, so hosting issues are caught on the spot instead of failing silently later
  • [UPDATE] If the connection breaks later on, Flavio repairs it automatically the next time you open it and picks up right where it left off
  • [FIX] Reconnecting is now safer: a failed attempt never invalidates credentials that were still working
  • [FIX] Uninstalling the plugin now removes all of Flavio’s access credentials from your site

1.3.0

  • [NEW] Flavio can now update content on pages built with the Classic Editor
  • [UPDATE] The activity timeline now shows when Flavio started working on each part of your site, and the exact date of every change made
  • [UPDATE] Added an extra check (‘sanitization’) on AI-generated content before it’s published to your site
  • [UPDATE] Activity and requests for your product pages are now grouped by page, with a filter to see only what’s waiting for your approval
  • [FIX] The requests list no longer gets stuck loading in some situations
  • [FIX] Fixed an issue that could make Flavio process the same task over and over

1.2.0

  • [NEW] Switch to Automatic mode right from your requests list, and clear everything Flavio can handle in one go
  • [NEW] A confirmation screen every time you switch between Automatic and Manual Review, so you always know what’s changing
  • [UPDATE] Requests are now grouped by Area, with the newest ones first
  • [UPDATE] Clearer button copy, so it’s obvious whether you’re publishing a change or leaving things as they are

1.1.0

  • [NEW] Automated on-page optimization: titles, meta descriptions, image alt text, FAQs, and structured data
  • [NEW] Page builder compatibility with Elementor, Divi, Gutenberg, Classic Editor, Beaver Builder
  • [NEW] Business profile setup with Google Places address autocomplete
  • [NEW] Guided Google Business Profile connection and description improvements
  • [NEW] Local SEO improvements: NAP consistency checks, contact page creation, and location pages
  • [NEW] Content strategy tools: duplicate title detection and content improvement suggestions
  • [NEW] Monthly site status reports with progress tracking
  • [NEW] Activity timeline showing every change Flavio makes to your site
  • [NEW] One-click undo for reversible changes
  • [NEW] Friendly, more readable URL suggestions
  • [UPDATE] Expanded error detection for broken pages and indexing issues

1.0.0

  • Initial release
  • AI-powered SEO suggestions
  • XML sitemap generator
  • Robots.txt manager
  • Broken links detection and automatic fixing
  • SEO site scan functionality
  • Task management system
  • Progress tracking and reporting
  • REST API integration
  • Modern admin interface
